question: Does token_refresh behavioral drift detection remain robust (TP >= 0.85, behavioral_std > 0.05) when co-occurring structural noise includes production-like complexity patterns (pagination metadata, variable-length response bodies, error format variation, CDN cache headers) rather than only the 4 simplistic field-level noise types tested in the parent?
hypothesis: Token_refresh behavioral detection (TP >= 0.85) and behavioral variance (std > 0.05) will survive co-occurring production-like structural noise at n=480, because the behavioral signal is derived from JWT validation status (token state, session validity, permission checks) which is independent of response body structure. The parent validated TP=1.0 under 4 simplistic noise types; this experiment tests robustness to structurally complex noise that mimics real API response variation.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if any of: (F1) token_refresh TP < 0.85 under co-occurring production-like noise at n=480, OR (F2) behavioral_std < 0.05 under co-occurring production-like noise at n=480, OR (F3) structural discrimination < 0.5 (positive control — auth-state HTTP fingerprint must still discriminate), OR (F4) FP > 0.15 on production-like noise-only samples, OR (F5) TOST at delta=0.15 fails (CI upper bound >= 0.15) for the full pooled sample at n=480. MIXED if C1-C4 pass but C5 fails (equivalence not confirmed under production-like noise).

B-SIMPLISTIC-NOISE-N480.description: Parent n=480 result with 4 simplistic noise types: TP=1.0 on all 4 token_refresh+noise conditions, behavioral_std 0.133-0.141, FP=0.0, TOST PASS at delta=0.15 (r=-0.037, CI upper 0.053).

B-ORTHOGONALITY-N480-MOCK.description: Four prior n=480 mock orthogonality experiments all confirm delta=0.15: EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (r=0.046, CI upper 0.135), EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 (r=0.0022, CI upper 0.0916), EXP-PRODUCT-35445596342 (r=-0.0258, CI upper 0.064), EXP-PRODUCT-35476271728 (r=-0.037, CI upper 0.053).
B-ORTHOGONALITY-N480-MOCK.expected_behavior: Production-like noise does not introduce behavioral-structural coupling that breaks orthogonality at delta=0.15

positive_control.description: HTTP fingerprint full-vector discrimination on stochastic Flask+SQLite mock server with 4 auth states (no_auth, valid_token, expired_token, invalid_token). Discrimination must exceed 0.5 to confirm the structural signal is operational.
positive_control.expected_behavior: Full-vector discrimination > 0.5 on auth-state changes (replicating parent 0.8333)

null_control.description: Behavioral false positive rate on production-like noise-only samples (4 production-like noise types x 60 samples = 240 noise-only samples, no drift active).

measurement_validity: Stochastic Flask+SQLite mock server matching EXP-PRODUCT-35476271728 (Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL-mode DB + in-memory cache TTL=0.5s + jitter 10-100ms + mixed JWT algorithms HS256/RS256)
Token_refresh drift: p_refresh_success=0.7 (Bernoulli), producing bimodal behavioral scores (~0.48 on failure, ~0.65 on success)

4 NEW production-like structural noise types (see noise_design below) REPLACE the 4 parent simplistic types for the co-occurring conditions; the parent types are used ONLY for the isolated baseline comparison
Server state fully reset between conditions (set_drift(None) clears all state)
N = 480 paired samples minimum (60 per condition x 8 co-occurring conditions) for token_refresh TP and orthogonality; additional 240 production-like noise-only samples for FP measurement
Orthogonality tested via TOST equivalence test at delta=0.15 on Fisher-z transformed Pearson correlation
All measurements on localhost mock server (127.0.0.1:18951), not production APIs
This experiment does NOT make real LLM calls
Global RNG seeded at 42 before server thread start; server runs threaded=False, client sequential

noise_design.description: 4 production-like structural noise types that mimic real API response variation. Each noise type modifies the response structure in a way that would naturally occur in production APIs, unlike the parent's 4 simplistic types (optional_field_addition, description_change, response_time_jitter, field_type_normalization) which are artificial field-level perturbations.

pagination_metadata.description: Adds pagination fields (page, per_page, total_count, has_next) to response body, simulating API list endpoints. Field count varies 2-6 per request. Structural effect: body key count varies by 2-6.

variable_length_data.description: Response body data_list length varies 0-8 items per request, simulating real API data return variation. Each item adds 3-5 keys. Structural effect: body key count varies by 0-40.

error_format_variation.description: Error responses use different formats depending on error type: 401 returns {error, message, code}, 403 returns {error, message, required_permission}, 500 returns {error, message, request_id}. Structural effect: body structure varies across status codes.

cdn_cache_headers.description: Adds CDN-specific response headers: X-Cache (HIT/MISS), X-CDN-Cache-Control (max-age varies 0-300), Age (varies 0-60), CF-Ray (random UUID). Structural effect: header count varies by 3-4.

noise_design.expected_total_structural_variance: Higher than parent's simplistic types due to multi-field and multi-format variation

decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of: (C1) structural discrimination > 0.5 (positive control), (C2) token_refresh TP >= 0.85 under co-occurring production-like noise at n=480, (C3) token_refresh behavioral_std > 0.05 under co-occurring production-like noise at n=480, (C4) FP <= 0.15 on production-like noise-only samples, (C5) TOST equivalence at delta=0.15 (CI upper bound < 0.15) for the full pooled sample. FALSIFIED if any condition fails. MIXED if C1-C4 pass but C5 fails (equivalence not confirmed under production-like noise despite adequate power).
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: token_refresh detection robust to production-like structural complexity; behavioral signal is not limited to simplistic noise patterns; strengthens case for production substrate readiness; C-FRESHNESS claim ceiling expanded to include realistic structural variation.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: token_refresh detection fragile under production-like structural complexity; behavioral signal couples with realistic response variation; production substrate must handle structural-behavioral coupling; C-FRESHNESS claim ceiling remains bounded to simplistic noise types only.
estimated_cost: Zero new LLM calls. Extends existing stochastic mock server with 4 new noise types. 480 paired phase-B samples + 240 production-like noise-only phase-C samples + 40 phase-A probes + 60 isolated TP samples = ~820 total HTTP cycles on localhost. Runtime ~35-45 minutes single-threaded. No API keys required.
expected_information_gain: MEDIUM-HIGH: directly tests whether the behavioral detection signal generalizes beyond simplistic noise patterns to realistic structural complexity. A positive result strengthens the production-readiness case; a negative result identifies a structural coupling vulnerability before the expensive production substrate is built. Either outcome changes the product architecture decision for C-FRESHNESS.
